Installation for some custom farm maps that alter the farm cave:

1. Download the respective custom farm's compatible file instead of the main file.
2. Extract the zip.
3. Drop everything including two image files into the /asset folder of the farm map that contains its "FarmCave.tbin" file,
    and replace it with my "FarmCave.tbin" file.
    (For example IFR2's cave file is located inside ".../Stardew Valley/Mods/.../[CP] Immersive Farm 2 Remastered/assets" folder.)
